def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    # Draw diagonal continuations for every repeated-color diagonal pair.
    for i,(r,c,v) in enumerate(pts):
        for rr,cc,vv in pts[i+1:]:
            if vv!=v or rr==r or abs(rr-r)!=abs(cc-c):
                continue
            dr=1 if rr>r else -1
            dc=1 if cc>c else -1
            # A continuation proceeds past the second point; the opposite ray
            # is added when there is a matching diagonal pair on that side.
            y,x=rr+dr,cc+dc
            while 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and out[y][x]==bg:
                out[y][x]=v
                y+=dr; x+=dc
    return out
